 21 Nov 2026 Team news: Eze in, Guimaraes starts at Newcastle
 Jonathon Rogers 0
 0
 0
 0
 0
 0
 Mikel Arteta has made one change to his side for this evening’s game against Newcastle United at St James’ Park, with Ebere Eze coming into the line-up.
 He replaces Christos Tzolis in the only change to our side that beat Hull City 1-0 two weeks ago before the international break, which means that Bruno Guimaraes starts against the club he captained before his summer switch to north London.
 William Saliba is included on the bench again as he looks for his first minutes of the campaign after his back injury, as is another former Magpie in Mikel Merino, although his Spanish international teammate Martin Zubimendi misses out after picking up an injury against England.
 How to watch Newcastle United v Arsenal live on TV Read more As for the hosts, Matthias Jaissle has made two switches from the team that drew 1-1 with Fulham two weeks ago at Craven Cottage.
 Former Gunner Joe Willock is included, with Yoane Wissa dropping to the bench, as has Nico Gonzalez who has struggled with illness this week, with Lewis Miley taking his spot in midfield.
 Jacob Ramsey has returned from a ban and is back on the bench.
 LINE-UP
 Arsenal:  Raya, Timber, Konsa, Gabriel, Calafiori, Guimaraes, Rice, Odegaard, Eze, Madueke, Havertz.
 Subs:  Arrizabalaga, White, Hincapie, Saliba, Mosquera, Lewis-Skelly, Merino, Tzolis, Gyokeres.
 Newcastle:  Horineck, Dedic, Thiaw, Burn, Hall, Miley, Steur, Murphy, Willock, Barnes, Osula.
 Subs:  Pope, Livramento, Schar, Botman, Gonzalez, Ramsey, Elanga, Fernandez-Pardo, Wissa.
